concept.zh: 按时刻开启的有向闸门
concept.en: Directed gates that open on specific ticks

brief.zh: 仓室编号为 0 到 rooms−1，每条单向闸道 [a,b,period,phase] 只在出发时刻除以 period 的余数等于 phase 时开放。过闸需 1 拍，在任意仓室可原地等候，起始时刻为 0。求从 start 到 finish 最早能在第几拍抵达，无法到达返回 -1。period 为正，phase 从 0 到 period−1。
brief.en: Rooms are numbered 0 through rooms−1. Each directed gate [a,b,period,phase] opens for departure only when the tick modulo period equals phase. Crossing costs one tick. Waiting in any room is allowed. Starting at tick 0, return the earliest arrival tick from start to finish, or -1 if unreachable. period is positive and phase lies from 0 through period−1.
